Verdict integration: the finding-side duplicate is directly present in source, and nearby source/spec integration shows an actual software-visible missing error-code branch, so the finding is confirmed.

Verdict integration: the original out-of-bounds claim is false, yet a ref-driven defect exists on the same key_length invalid-configuration path, so this is confirmed as an extra finding.
